# adr-cli

> Create, list, link and supersede Architecture Decision Records in the adr-tools Markdown format, with exclusive creates and atomic updates. Python package `trysac-adr-cli`, import name `adr_cli`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model, defended and undefended risks
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and what the tests cover

## Optional

- [Project](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope
- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools used and discarded
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): release history
